judul: Danshi Koukousei wo Yashinaitai Onee-san no Hanashi.
author: Hideki
synopsis: When Soramoto Minoru’s parents left him with a heavy debt, the “Onee-san” next door saves him and takes him in. Thus begins Minoru’s new, strange life with the beautiful Onee-san that thinks he’s too cute and wants to keep him!
